newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Clinical Chapter 11 plan okayed.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Clinical Chapter 11 plan okayed.

text.p: Physicians Clinical Laboratory Inc said its Chapter 11 reorganization plan was approved by a U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Califoria.
"We are very pleased that our restructuring plan has been approved by the Court," a company spokesperson said.
"Our creditors and shareholders have also overwhelming approved the Plan, and the Company will emerge from Chapter 11 in the next few weeks." The company said the plan was approved Friday.
The restructuring plan resulted in a significant reduction of debt and an infusion of new capital into the business, the company said.
